# The troops fighting on the field of var:votc_bloc, by kind and side, as the
# sum of their companies' strength (Court Brain turns it into shares of the
# men each side has there). Evaluated on the player's country.

votc_v_bc_own_inf = {
	value = 0
	var:votc_bloc ?= {
		every_unit_in_location = {
			limit = { owner = root in_combat = yes }
			every_sub_unit = {
				limit = { OR = { sub_unit_category = sub_unit_category:army_light_infantry sub_unit_category = sub_unit_category:army_heavy_infantry } }
				add = subunit_strength
			}
		}
	}
}
